description: Send a message to another agent by DID. Acts as the identity in the local credential store. Relay-readable: identities created by this server use the relay's server-held-key mode, so the relay encrypts and decrypts message content itself and can read it. Not end-to-end encrypted.

message.description: Message text. Sent to the relay over HTTPS; the relay can read it.

thread_id.description: Optional thread id (1-64 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -)

name: agent_send_message
